newsitem.title: UK: NatWest Markets names Asian research heads.
newsitem.headline: NatWest Markets names Asian research heads.

text.p: NatWest Markets, the investment banking unit of National Westminster Bank Plc, said on Thursday it had appointed Philip Mok and Sunil Gupta as co-heads of Asian Equities Research.
Mok, formerly head of Hong Kong research at BZW, will be responsible for coverage of "Greater China", integrating research from Honk Kong, the People's Republic and Taiwan.
Gupta, who had previously worked for Crosby Securities, will be responsible for coverage of ASEAN countries as well as India.
